title: The frozen-path guard refuses `FOO=$(date +%s) cp x T` once the wrapper stack meets main
why: Lane bg-tail-loses-verdict, 16:00 CST Nov 8, from round-3 or later reviews; queued follow-up the lane starts when its wait ends. Waits on the #2113/#2208/#2241 batch. The command is allowed once the stack meets main's bc6087abb (`word.rstrip(")`")` at merged guard_frozen.py:783 plus `_after_assignment`); main and the stack each deny it alone. A safety hole the merge would open.
